title: BRICS backs diversified energy mix, says fossil fuels remain important for EMDEs
description: BRICS nations advocate for stronger energy security through diverse sources and stable markets. They acknowledge fossil fuels' continued importance for developing economies. The group also called for equitable and inclusive energy transitions globally. Cooperation on critical minerals and digital technologies in energy systems was endorsed. BRICS also seeks to deepen ties in advanced manufacturing and emerging technologies.
